messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands with their back to the camera, then turns slightly and begins walking forward away from the camera.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium shot from directly behind the subject.","clothing":"A cream-colored cable-knit sweater, blue pants, and tan boots.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled back into a small ponytail or bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A person with a slim build, seen from behind, with dark skin visible on the neck and arms.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park or fairground with a carousel on the left, a swing ride on the right, and a paved walkway in the center under a bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a foggy brick street with a Union Jack flag to a bright fairground with a carousel on the left, swing ride on the right, and a wide paved area. The person remains seen from behind with blue hair, cream cable-knit sweater, blue pants, and tan boots, performing a similar standing/turning/walking-away motion. The lighting on the person now appears warmer and brighter, consistent with the fairground.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original street scene with the reference amusement-park environment while keeping the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged, preserving camera framing/movement and adapting the person's lighting to the new scene.
uncertain: Whether the camera framing and movement are exactly preserved, since the new scene changes the visible horizon and subject scale slightly.
unexpected_changes: The person's pants appear darker blue in the output than the lighter blue jeans in the source.
